name: @mqtt-toolbox/workspace
description: MQTT Toolbox 2, built on the Dagda framework
author: Matthieu Aubry

scripts.watch: npm run watch -w @mqtt-toolbox/client & npm run watch -w @mqtt-toolbox/server & wait
scripts.dev: npm run db:up && npm run build && (npm run watch -w @mqtt-toolbox/client & npm run watch -w @mqtt-toolbox/server & npm run dev -w @mqtt-toolbox/server & wait)
